title: Del Rosario defends Gilas amid Asiad criticism: ‘We play to win’
summary: Gilas Pilipinas’ title-retention bid in the Asian Games came to an unfortunate end at the hands of rival China, with the revamped roster crashing out in the group stage for the first time since 2014.
